header.title: Audio Summarizer
header.description: Record meetings, lectures, or podcasts and get a structured summary with key points, content type detection, and action items.

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.placeholder: Record audio above or paste a transcript here...

livePaste.title: Live Recording + Paste
livePaste.description: Record directly from your microphone or paste an existing transcript from any source — meeting notes, podcast apps, or video captions.

structured.title: Structured Output
structured.description: Results are broken into a title, overview, numbered key points, a detailed summary, and a checklist of action items.

contentType.title: Content Type Detection
contentType.description: Automatically identifies whether the audio was a lecture, interview, meeting, podcast, or speech and tailors the summary accordingly.

items.clarity: Speak clearly and at normal pace — the browser speech API performs best in quiet environments.
items.speakers: For pasted transcripts, include speaker names if available — the AI uses them to structure the summary better.
items.actionItems: The action items section works best when the recording includes explicit decisions or assignments.
items.length: Summarise recordings under 30 minutes for the most focused output.

purpose.question: What is the audio summarizer for?
purpose.answer: Recording lectures, meetings, or spoken notes and getting a structured summary instead of a wall of transcript. It is useful whenever listening back to a recording would take too long.

includes.question: What does the summary include?
includes.answer: An overview, the key points, and any action items detected in the conversation, plus a guess at the content type (lecture, meeting, and so on).

browsers.question: Which browsers are supported?
browsers.answer: Chrome, Edge, and Safari. Transcription uses the browser's Web Speech API, which Firefox does not support, and you must grant microphone permission.

existingFile.question: Can I summarize an existing audio file?
existingFile.answer: Not directly — the tool transcribes live microphone audio. Playing a recording out loud near your mic can work, but expect lower transcription accuracy.

cost.question: What does it cost?
cost.answer: Recording and transcription are free since they happen in your browser. The AI summary costs text tokens based on transcript length, roughly 1 token per 6 characters.
